description: The Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal Dataset from Google Research gives annual rasters of building presence, fractional building counts and building heights for eight years, 2016 to 2023, over about 58 million square kilometres. It is produced from Sentinel-2 imagery, with a revisit of about five days, by a model whose effective spatial resolution is about 4 metres, and the rasters are delivered at 50 cm. Coverage: Africa, South Asia, South-East Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the same area as Open Buildings version 3, with a country list that may change. Access: one Earth Engine Image Collection with three bands, or raster downloads from Google Cloud Storage through a provided notebook. Licence: CC BY 4.0 or ODbL 1.0, at the user's choice; free. Caveats: the effective resolution means small buildings and exact roof positions are uncertain, and the high-resolution imagery and labels used to train the teacher model are not released. Simulation uses are tracking settlement growth into hazard zones over time, updating exposure between census years and estimating building volume from heights. Related records: Google Open Buildings and the VIDA combined footprints.
